lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So walk me through the flow one more time, start to finish.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You open the app and it goes straight to the camera. No home screen, no dashboard.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: You take the photo of the fridge.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We show you what we recognised, and you can tap to remove anything that's wrong.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then three suggestions, and you pick one.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: And picking one takes you to the steps. That's the whole thing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Five screens at most, by my count.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Four, if the recognition screen and the suggestions screen are the same screen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Sotto, can you sketch the user flow we just described as a diagram?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yeah, I want to see whether it looks as simple as it sounds.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: If it needs a legend, we've already overbuilt it.
